name: Shopping cart
summary: Metal supermarket trolley with wheels and a few groceries; anim roll spins the wheels as it is pushed.

params.name: y
params.note: floor point under the wheels (1 m ~ 560 px)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 0.75 m wide and 1.2 m tall; use about 0.5 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: roll = wheels spin and the load bobs slightly

author: krakujs
